morphology.pattern_note: 外来地理专名，作为整词记忆；不能拆成马来语词根和词缀。规范行文首字母大写；所列 IPA 为英语通行读法，马来语使用者的实际读音可有差异。

senses.zh_definition: 埃佛勒斯峰，即珠穆朗玛峰；位于尼泊尔与中国边界的喜马拉雅山峰，为世界海拔最高峰。
senses.en_definition: Mount Everest, the Himalayan peak on the Nepal–China border and the world's highest mountain above sea level.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi Gunung Everest, gunung di Himalaya pada sempadan Nepal dengan China yang merupakan gunung tertinggi di dunia berdasarkan ketinggian dari aras laut.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，马来语通常写 Gunung Everest。输入的小写形式为检索词形；本释义为地理说明，并非声称存在相应 DBP 普通词条。以下为常用指称组合。[美国国会图书馆：Mount Everest](https://blogs.loc.gov/maps/2018/03/extremities-of-the-earth-the-highest-point-from-sea-level/)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 登山活动报道
dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan pendaki itu sedang membuat persediaan untuk ekspedisi ke Gunung Everest.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该登山队正在为前往珠穆朗玛峰的探险做准备。
dual_scenarios.en: The climbing team is preparing for an expedition to Mount Everest.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak pergi ke kem induk Everest je, bukan naik sampai puncak.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Aku hanya mahu pergi ke kem induk Everest, bukannya mendaki hingga ke puncak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我只是想去珠峰大本营，又不是要登顶。
dual_scenarios.en: I just want to go to Everest Base Camp, not climb to the summit.
spoken_features: je 对应 sahaja，表示范围限制。
naik sampai puncak 是口语表达，正式可说 mendaki hingga ke puncak。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, kem induk je! Aku ingat kau nak sampai puncak tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, hanya ke kem induk! Aku menyangka bahawa kau mahu mendaki hingga ke puncak.
messages.zh: 哦，只去大本营啊！我刚还以为你要登顶呢。
messages.en: Oh, just base camp! I thought you meant going all the way to the top.

etymology.historical_story: Everest commemorates George Everest, a former Surveyor General of India. His successor, Andrew Waugh, proposed the name, which Britain's Royal Geographical Society adopted in 1865. The mountain also has established regional names, including Chomolungma and Sagarmatha. Its international English name therefore reflects surveying history rather than a Malay description of height or mountains. [Library of Congress](https://blogs.loc.gov/maps/2018/03/extremities-of-the-earth-the-highest-point-from-sea-level/), [Royal Society: George Everest](https://catalogues.royalsociety.org/CalmView/Record.aspx?id=NA1188&src=CalmView.Persons)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Everest 整体连接到“珠峰”的雪山画面，再记 Gunung＝山：Gunung Everest。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 地理专名本身语气中性。正式马来语文本写 Everest 或 Gunung Everest，保留首字母大写。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 涉及当地文化时，应尊重 Chomolungma 和 Sagarmatha 等名称。谈登山行程时，明确区分 kem induk（大本营）与 puncak（峰顶）。
